notes.title: Обновление 1.0
notes.content: So there was an update that was announced last week. The game has become longer. The last room I think turned out to be glorious. It is unlikely that you will be able to get through it from 1 time. Added zombie hp. Now he needs to inflict more blows or shots on him. Fixed several bugs. Unfortunately, I am not an encoder and could not fix saves, sorry. Thank you for supporting. I will try further. Report bugs.
